question: For veg whsle data, can you analyze our financial performance over the years 2020 to 2023? I need insights into the average wholesale price, maximum wholesale price, minimum wholesale price, wholesale price difference, total wholesale price, total selling price, average loss rate, total loss, and profit for each category within each year. Round all calculated values to two decimal places.
sql:
-- Verify row count
WITH wholesale_agg AS (
  SELECT 
    substr(w.whsle_date, 1, 4) AS year,
    c.category_name,
    AVG(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") AS avg_wholesale_price,
    MAX(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") AS max_wholesale_price,
    MIN(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") AS min_wholesale_price,
    MAX(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") - MIN(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") AS wholesale_price_difference,
    SUM(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") AS total_wholesale_price
  FROM veg_whsle_df w
  JOIN veg_cat c ON w.item_code = c.item_code
  WHERE substr(w.whsle_date, 1, 4) BETWEEN '2020' AND '2023'
  GROUP BY substr(w.whsle_date, 1, 4), c.category_name
),
selling_agg AS (
  SELECT 
    substr(t.txn_date, 1, 4) AS year,
    c.category_name,
    SUM(t."unit_selling_px_rmb/kg" * t."qty_sold(kg)") AS total_selling_price
  FROM veg_txn_df t
  JOIN veg_cat c ON t.item_code = c.item_code
  WHERE substr(t.txn_date, 1, 4) BETWEEN '2020' AND '2023'
    AND t."sale/return" = 'sale'
  GROUP BY substr(t.txn_date, 1, 4), c.category_name
),
loss_agg AS (
  SELECT 
    c.category_name,
    AVG(l."loss_rate_%") AS avg_loss_rate,
    SUM(l."loss_rate_%") AS total_loss
  FROM veg_loss_rate_df l
  JOIN veg_cat c ON l.item_code = c.item_code
  GROUP BY c.category_name
)
SELECT 
  wa.year,
  wa.category_name,
  ROUND(wa.avg_wholesale_price, 2) AS avg_wholesale_price,
  ROUND(wa.max_wholesale_price, 2) AS max_wholesale_price,
  ROUND(wa.min_wholesale_price, 2) AS min_wholesale_price,
  ROUND(wa.wholesale_price_difference, 2) AS wholesale_price_difference,
  ROUND(wa.total_wholesale_price, 2) AS total_wholesale_price,
  ROUND(sa.total_selling_price, 2) AS total_selling_price,
  ROUND(la.avg_loss_rate, 2) AS avg_loss_rate,
  ROUND(la.total_loss, 2) AS total_loss,
  ROUND(sa.total_selling_price - wa.total_wholesale_price, 2) AS profit
FROM wholesale_agg wa
JOIN selling_agg sa ON wa.year = sa.year AND wa.category_name = sa.category_name
JOIN loss_agg la ON wa.category_name = la.category_name
ORDER BY wa.year, wa.category_name
